name: Cindy for iOS
desc: Mobile app that mirrors and drives the Cindy agent on your computers.
desc_zh: 镜像并操控跑在你电脑上的 Cindy 智能体的手机应用。
solves: An agent working on your desktop is invisible when you leave the desk; the phone mirrors the task and keeps it moving.
solves_zh: 智能体在你台式机上干活，你一离开工位就看不见了；手机镜像任务并让它继续。
best_for: You left a Cindy task running and want to answer its question from your phone.
best_for_zh: 你留下一个 Cindy 任务在跑，想用手机回答它的提问。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：A — Apple App Store listing; D — cindy.app）。 Official App Store record for "Cindy - AI Assistant" by XD Entertainment Pte Ltd (trackId 6787894640); the listing describes the mobile app as Cindy’s remote command centre. Same product family as the ledger’s Cindy@2026-07-25 (cindy.app, XD.INC / PROJECT CINDY), so this is the mobile entry point rather than a new vendor. 入库核对（2026-11-25）：形态枚举没有手机应用；账本里手机应用记为 web。 厂商没有公布中文名，name_zh 按 name。 首次公开日期来源：https://itunes.apple.com/lookup?id=6787894640&country=us
